paths.title: AI Image Creation Academy
paths.tagline: From your first sharp prompt to a repeatable creative pipeline, using the two AI tools you already have open: ChatGPT and Gemini.
paths.description: An 8-lesson path covering the full AI image generation workflow inside ChatGPT (GPT Image 2) and Gemini's native image generation: writing effective prompts, choosing which of the two tools to lead with for a given job, iterating through conversational refinement and variation, generating accurate product photos and mockups, keeping social and marketing visuals on-brand with saved ChatGPT Projects and Gemini Gems, handling text in images and graphic design work, understanding commercial safety across plan tiers, and building a documented pipeline that ties it all together.
